findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name File path traversal
 * @description Using untrusted input in file operations can lead to path traversal attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "remove", "unlink", "rename", "chmod", "chown"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember(["Path", "PurePath"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall()
select call, "File operation that could be vulnerable to path traversal if using untrusted input."
